jobs.description_text: About Tahoe Therapeutics Tahoe Therapeutics is a biotechnology company working on building the ground truth for biological superintelligence. Our Mosaic platform is the first to make in vivo data generation scalable, with single-cell resolution, allowing us to map how drugs affect patient-derived cells in the body across a wide range of biological contexts. Efficient, fast and cost-effective access to data at large scale is key to tackle the hardest problems in AD/ADAS, from developing the Machine Learning (ML) models for perception and prediction of human driving patterns, to increasing the sophistication of our validation and simulation by identifying rare and interesting real-world driving situations. The data ecosystem developed by the London team is a key building block for developing and testing modern AD/ADAS products that will impact millions of customers. Our ML and Data pipelines are built on-top of the open-source Flyte orchestration framework and are deployed to AWS. Pipeline code is written in Python. We use SQS and Kafka to automate data connections and leverage BigQuery and ElasticSearch for data storage. jobs.description_text: As a Analyst – Intelligence & Advisory, you will work alongside AHEAD’s consultants and practice teams at the intersection of technology, AI and business - turning ambiguous business questions from consulting teams into structured, hypothesis-led research and clear, actionable recommendations. You will independently own deliverables end-to-end, act as a credible thought partner to onsite consulting and pursuit teams, and help raise the quality bar by guiding junior analysts. Your work will directly shape how AHEAD’s consulting teams understand markets, position against competitors, plan for accounts, and win complex enterprise technology deals — and how sharply those insights are communicated to CXO audiences. You will scope and prioritize requests, clarify objectives, and select the right insights on clients, markets, offerings and competition to address them. You will conduct data-driven analyses and turn the results into accurate, client-ready documents, models and charts, and join team problem-solving discussions so that recommendations are actionable and strategically relevant. Beyond individual requests, you will help build and maintain AHEAD’s knowledge assets, databases and proposal and use-case material, using scripts and automation to prepare and validate data, while continuing to grow with the industry. jobs.title: Citrix & Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) Architect
jobs.description_text: We are looking for an experienced Citrix & Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) Architect with 12–15 years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, EUC, virtualization, Citrix and Microsoft Azure. The candidate must have strong hands-on experience with Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Nerdio Manager for Enterprise, FSLogix, Azure infrastructure, Citrix ADC/NetScaler and PowerShell automation. The role will be responsible for architecture, design, implementation, migration, optimization, security, automation, monitoring and technical leadership across enterprise Citrix and AVD environments. The candidate should have proven experience leading Citrix-to-AVD migration and cloud transformation projects and should be comfortable working with global stakeholders in an EST time-zone shift.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer - Azure
jobs.description_text: The Cloud Engineer - Managed Services is responsible for the day-to-day operation, administration, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement of customer cloud environments across public Clouds such as Azure, AWS, GCP or OCI. This role is primarily focused on cloud operations, service delivery, governance execution, incident/request/change support, documentation, and customer communication, with secondary exposure to automation, DevOps, and reliability practices where they improve operational consistency and scale. The role is expected to independently own standard and moderately complex operational execution and troubleshooting while escalating novel, high-risk, architecture-heavy, or major platform engineering work to senior engineers and architects as appropriate. This is an on-site role, with core working hours aligned to Eastern Time (EST).

jobs.title: Director of Supply Chain
jobs.description_text: The Director of Supply Chain continually works to maximize the value generated by the AHEAD Foundry supply chain by optimizing the flow of goods and information between vendors, AHEAD Foundry, and customers. They strengthen and expand vendor relationships, maintain efficient inventory levels, and work closely with sales to develop strong forecasting disciplines. They are keenly aware of market trends in computer server components and work closely with vendors on supply-side planning. They work to reduce logistics and warehousing costs while developing accurate, vital metrics with which to measure success and ongoing progress. They oversee all purchasing, warehousing, and logistics functions, along with key vendor relationships, and lead a team of Buyers with varying degrees of responsibility and specialties

jobs.title: Director, Financial Solutions
jobs.description_text: AHEAD is seeking a Director, Financial Solutions to join our Financial Solutions Group (FSG). This role supports a geographic territory aligned with sales and partners closely with sales leadership, clients, accounts receivable, manufacturers, and internal finance teams. The Director, Financial Solutions helps AHEAD structure strategic financing solutions, improve cash outcomes, support complex transactions, and enable financial selling across the business. The ideal candidate combines strong financial-selling experience with commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Engineering Technician
jobs.description_text: The Engineering Technician is responsible for supporting day-to-day tasks within the AHEAD Foundry Engineering group. The role is also solely responsible for tasks assigned by the Engineering Technician Manager or Product Engineer Manager, which will include activities such as working within Excel workbooks, providing a quote for services or products and creating part numbers within a company portal. Other activities may include creating and maintaining BOMs, reviewing Engineering Change Orders, triage production tickets and maintaining documentation for work instructions.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description_text: The Executive Assistant serves as a trusted and highly proactive partner to one or more C-level executives at AHEAD. By protecting executive time, anticipating needs, organizing competing priorities, and driving follow-through, this role creates the leverage needed to focus on the highest-value work. A central part of the role is making day-to-day executive work easier by knowing what is needed before it is requested, removing friction, and creating a smooth, well-organized experience around the work. The ideal candidate brings exceptional judgment, discretion, organization, and communication skills. They are comfortable operating with limited direction, quickly distinguish what is urgent from what is important, and represent executive leadership and AHEAD with professionalism and polish in every interaction.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Field Marketing Manager, you will lead the development and execution of integrated marketing plans that generate awareness and drive pipeline growth across AHEAD’s Central Region. This highly collaborative role partners closely with marketing, sales, and external agencies to align strategy, ensure flawless execution, and report on performance and outcomes. Serving as the primary bridge between the Central Region and the broader marketing organization, you will ensure tight coordination across teams, consistency in messaging and branding, and effective activation of campaigns, partner initiatives, and regional deliverables. You’ll also champion regional engagement in national campaigns—helping to localize content, refine audience targeting, and align messaging to meet regional business needs. The ideal candidate brings a strong track record in field marketing and a hands-on approach to execution. This position reports directly to the Director of Field Marketing. It offers a unique opportunity to make a direct and measurable impact on regional business growth.

jobs.title: Financed Contracts Billing and Collections Specialist
jobs.description_text: The Financed Contracts Billing and Collections Specialist manages the billing, payment tracking, collections, reconciliation, and cash-application activities associated with customer-financed receivables. This role owns the operational flow from approved financing documentation through invoice submission, payment follow-up, reconciliation, and funding or cash application. The specialist works closely with AHEAD’s Finance and Accounting Department, Financial Solutions Group, Financial Solutions Leads (FSLs), and leasing partners to ensure that financed transactions are billed accurately, payments are collected on time, records remain complete and traceable, and exceptions are resolved through the appropriate financial channels. This is a hands-on role for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who is comfortable working with contract and financial data and confident managing professional businessto-business payment communications.

jobs.title: Lead Hardware Returns Specialist
jobs.description_text: The Lead Hardware Returns Specialist is responsible for leading the daily processing of defective, damaged, non-conforming, and customer-owned computer hardware for return to manufacturers and vendors. This role performs the core functions of the Hardware Returns Specialist while providing day-to-day direction, coordination, training, and operational support for the returns team. Ensures accurate product verification, documentation, inventory control, RMA processing, vendor returns, and outbound shipments. The role is also responsible for monitoring department performance, resolving process issues, supporting cross-functional communication, and helping maintain consistent operations across multiple facilities located on the same campus.The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, process-driven, technically capable, and able to lead by example in a fast-paced warehouse and reverse-logistics environment. jobs.description_text: About Xsolla Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. About the Role We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own the smart wallet and account abstraction layer of Xsolla's Web3 platform. This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. You'll own the primitives underneath all of it: the ERC-4337 user operation lifecycle, EIP-7702 delegation, session keys and origin-bound Smart Sessions, paymaster and gas abstraction strategy, and the custody and recovery roadmap — including the move from raw key export to MPC custody.
